name: claude-pacing
description: Pacing for Claude Code: spend the weekly plan allowance on purpose over a ladder of models.

plugins.name: pacing
plugins.description: Use better models and still save tokens: the top tier does the hardest work, cheaper models take easier work as subagents. One budget paces the weekly meters. 4 different agent roles, each stays with the session and keeps notes per project, and a long session hands its work over to a new one. A status line shows the budget and each tier's share.
